items.title: Lavinia Bistro — QR Menu
items.intro: A photo-rich, multilingual QR menu for a 60-seat bistro in Istanbul. Loads in under a second, the owner updates everything from her phone, and tourists order in their own language.
items.problem: The bistro reprinted menus three times a year, lost tourist orders because of language barriers, and waited 6 weeks for any menu change from their previous agency.
items.approach: We built a custom mobile-first menu with photographs, allergen tags and a 5-language switcher. The admin panel lets the owner add items, change prices and update photos from her phone in seconds. We added 'call waiter' and 'request bill' buttons to reduce service queue.
items.result: Menu reprints went to zero. Tourist attach-rate on desserts and drinks rose 38%. Owner edits the menu herself — no developer involved.
highlights: 5 languages: TR / EN / DE / RU / AR
Call-waiter and request-bill actions reduce service queue
Allergen and dietary tags on every item
Owner edits items and prices from her phone — no developer

items.title: Rain Group — Home Décor Shopify
items.intro: A premium Shopify store for a home textiles and décor brand — minimal, trustworthy and built to sell internationally.
items.problem: Rain Group had a beautiful product line but was selling only through wholesale. They needed a direct-to-consumer store, English and Turkish, with international shipping.
items.approach: We designed a custom Shopify theme around their photography. Multilingual setup (TR/EN), international shipping zones, and a full creative system for Meta Ads. We also handled the brand voice and product photography direction.
items.result: DTC channel launched in 6 weeks. Organic traffic grew 60% in the first quarter. Meta Ads ROAS settled at 3.4x after creative testing.
highlights: Meta Ads + creative production by Velkina
ROAS 3.4x on paid Meta after creative testing

items.title: Dr. Sevim Aydın Beauty
items.intro: A modern, trustworthy website for an aesthetic clinic — presenting services clearly and converting visits into bookings.
items.problem: A respected clinic with no online presence. Patients found them through word-of-mouth only. They lost younger clients who searched on Google or Instagram.
items.approach: We designed a calm, trust-driven site, integrated an online appointment system, and laid the SEO foundations. Treatment pages were structured around the questions real patients ask.
items.result: Organic visibility +40%. Mobile sessions reached 70% of traffic. The clinic now books new patients online every week.
highlights: Mobile sessions grew to 70% of traffic
Trust signals (real before/after, doctor credentials, reviews)

items.title: TP Thermoplast — B2B Manufacturing
items.intro: A B2B website for a plastics manufacturer to win export-oriented buyers. Multilingual catalog and inquiry forms tuned for industrial buyers.
items.problem: TP Thermoplast had been an exporter for 20 years but their old website didn't reflect the company's scale. International buyers couldn't find product specs in their language.
items.approach: Multilingual structure (TR/EN/DE), structured product catalog with downloadable spec sheets, inquiry forms that capture project requirements, and 50% faster page-load.
items.result: Page load time cut by 50%. International inquiry volume grew measurably. The site became a serious touchpoint for export buyers.
highlights: Multilingual structure → speaks to export-oriented buyers
Inquiry forms tuned for industrial buyers

items.title: EduTurkia — Student Platform
items.intro: An education consultancy platform for international students applying to Turkish universities. Application management, CRM integration and a university catalog.
items.problem: A consultancy was managing hundreds of student applications in spreadsheets. Documents got lost, deadlines slipped, and parents couldn't track progress.
items.approach: We built a custom platform with student records, university catalog, application pipeline and admin panel. CRM integration so the sales team sees the whole journey in one place. Multilingual (TR/EN).
items.result: Student tracking went 100% digital. Application volume grew measurably after SEO and ads integration. Parents now check progress on their own dashboard.
highlights: Custom platform — student records, applications, universities
SEO + ads → significant increase in applications

items.title: Clown 3D — Creative Studio
items.intro: A playful, modern site for a 3D design and visualization studio that wanted prospects to feel their creative range from the first second.
items.problem: A talented studio with a portfolio buried in static images. They needed prospects to feel the work, not just see it.
items.approach: Dynamic animations, scroll-driven 3D reveals, and a creative portfolio structure that organizes projects by sector. SEO baked in so the right clients find them.
items.result: Strong first impression that matches the studio's energy. Improved organic visibility brought in inbound enquiries from international agencies.

items.title: Atar Avcı — Law Firm
items.intro: A professional, trust-driven website for a law practice — services laid out clearly, contact forms tuned for serious enquiries.
items.problem: A respected lawyer with referrals as their only channel. Younger clients searched online first; without a site, the firm was invisible.
items.approach: Minimal personal-brand design, plain-language service pages (not legalese), and SEO around the cases real clients search for.
items.result: Higher inquiry conversion. Improved search visibility on commercial legal terms. The site became a credibility check for every referral.
highlights: Contact forms tuned for serious enquiries

items.title: Anatolia Hotel — Direct Bookings
items.intro: A direct-booking website and Google Ads program for a 40-room boutique hotel that wanted to reduce dependence on Booking.com commission.
items.problem: The hotel paid 18% commission to OTAs on every booking. They had no direct channel and no way to email past guests.
items.approach: A beautiful direct-booking site with an integrated booking engine, Google Ads on brand and high-intent terms, and an email program for past guests. Multilingual (TR/EN/DE).
items.result: Direct bookings grew to 28% of total volume. OTA commission cost dropped by a third. Past guests now book directly with a discount code.
highlights: Google Ads on brand and high-intent terms
Direct bookings rose to 28% of total

items.title: Nova Health — AWS Migration
items.intro: A migration from creaky shared hosting to a properly architected AWS setup for a healthcare platform with strict uptime needs.
items.problem: Nova Health was on shared hosting that went down twice a month. No backups, no monitoring, no idea what to do in an incident.
items.approach: We migrated their stack to AWS (ECS + RDS + S3 + CloudFront), set up monitoring with CloudWatch and Sentry, automated daily backups with point-in-time restore, and wrote a runbook for incidents.
items.result: Uptime climbed from ~95% to 99.95%. Monthly cloud bill is lower than the old shared hosting + downtime cost. Backups now actually restore.
highlights: AWS architecture — ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront
Lower total cost than legacy hosting

items.title: Bosporus Travel — AI Customer Agent
items.intro: An AI customer agent that answers 80% of inbound WhatsApp messages for a tour operator — in 4 languages, around the clock.
items.problem: Bosporus Travel was drowning in WhatsApp messages from tourists asking the same 20 questions at 2am. Tour bookings were slipping because replies came too late.
items.approach: We built a custom AI agent trained on their tours, prices and FAQs. It handles inbound WhatsApp messages, books simple tours autonomously, and escalates complex ones to a human with full context.
items.result: 80% of inbound messages handled by the agent. Response time dropped from 4 hours to 30 seconds. Tour bookings rose during the night-time window.
highlights: Trained on tours, prices and FAQs
Escalates complex cases with full context

items.title: Skyline Media — Mobile App
items.intro: A cross-platform mobile app for a media subscription service — content discovery, offline reading, and push notifications.
items.problem: Skyline had a popular website but couldn't get readers to come back daily. They needed a mobile experience that fit into a commute.
items.approach: We built a React Native app with offline-first content sync, push notifications for breaking stories, and a recommendation feed tuned for short reading sessions.
items.result: Daily active users tripled in the first quarter. Average session length is 4× higher than web. Push opt-in is at 62%.
highlights: React Native — one codebase, two platforms
DAU 3× higher than web in Q1

items.title: Marmara Foods — Google Ads Growth
items.intro: A managed Google Ads program for a specialty foods e-commerce brand — Search, Shopping and remarketing tuned monthly.
items.problem: Marmara Foods was running ads on autopilot with a tool. ROAS was inconsistent, and they couldn't tell which campaigns made money.
items.approach: We restructured the account around clear themes, set up proper conversion tracking with enhanced conversions, ran weekly creative tests, and reported honestly each month — including the campaigns we paused.
items.result: Account ROAS settled at 4.2x. Cost per acquisition dropped 31% in 90 days. The team now sees a single dashboard with revenue, not just clicks.
highlights: Honest monthly reporting (including what we paused)

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: We keep it simple. We do not sell personal data. We collect minimal analytics to improve our website and services.

sections.title: Controller & Contact
body: Velkina ("Velkina", "we", "us") acts as the data controller for personal data processed through our website and client engagements.
Contact: omercannalbant@hotmail.com

sections.title: Scope
body: This policy covers data collected via our website, forms, emails, messaging apps and during service delivery to clients. It does not cover third-party websites linked from our site.

sections.title: Data We Collect
body: Contact data (name, email, phone, company)
Project and commercial information (requirements, scope, budget, timeline)
Technical data (IP, device, browser); privacy-safe analytics and server-side events
Support records and communications
Recruitment data for candidates (CV, portfolio)

sections.title: Purposes & Legal Bases
body: Provide and improve services; perform a contract or take steps prior to entering one
Respond to inquiries and schedule meetings; legitimate interests
Security, fraud prevention and abuse detection; legitimate interests
Compliance with legal obligations (tax, accounting)
Marketing with consent where required; you may opt out at any time

sections.title: Retention
body: We keep personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described or as required by law. Project records are typically retained for up to 6 years for legal/accounting reasons.

sections.title: Sharing & Recipients
body: Service providers under contract (hosting, communications, analytics, payments)
Professional advisors (accountants, lawyers) bound by confidentiality
Authorities where required by law
We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: International Transfers
body: Where data is transferred outside your jurisdiction, we use appropriate safeguards (e.g., SCCs/adequacy decisions).

sections.title: Security
body: We implement technical and organizational measures including access controls, encryption in transit, least-privilege credentials and audit logging. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.

sections.title: Your Rights
body: Subject to law, you may request access, rectification, deletion, restriction, portability or objection to processing. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting prior processing.
Contact: omercannalbant@hotmail.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking
body: We prefer privacy-safe analytics. Some features require cookies or similar technologies. You can control cookies in your browser.

sections.title: Children
body: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 13/16 as applicable by law.

sections.title: Changes
body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be indicated by updating the "Last updated" date.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.desc: By using our website and services, you agree to these terms. Project-specific terms are defined in our MSA/SOW.

sections.title: Definitions
body: "Velkina" means Velkina. "Client" means the person or entity receiving services. "Services" means the work described in an Order, SOW or proposal.

sections.title: Scope & Orders
body: We will provide the Services described in a mutually agreed Order/Proposal/SOW (the "Order"). Changes to scope require written agreement and may affect fees and timelines.

sections.title: Client Responsibilities
body: Provide timely access to information, systems and decision-makers. Review and approve deliverables without undue delay. Ensure all provided materials do not infringe third-party rights.

sections.title: Fees & Payment
body: Fees are as stated in the Order. Unless otherwise agreed, invoices are due within 14 days. Late payments may incur interest at the maximum rate permitted by law. All fees are exclusive of taxes.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
body: Upon full payment, Client owns the bespoke deliverables created specifically for the Client, excluding Velkina background IP, open-source components and third-party materials. Velkina grants a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to background IP solely as embedded in the deliverables.

sections.title: Confidentiality
body: Each party shall keep confidential information received from the other confidential and use it only to perform the Agreement, subject to customary exceptions (public domain, independently developed, legally required disclosure).

sections.title: Data Protection
body: Where personal data is processed, the parties will comply with applicable data protection laws. A separate DPA may apply where Velkina acts as processor.

sections.title: Warranties
body: We warrant that we will perform Services in a professional and workmanlike manner. Except as expressly stated, Services are provided "as is" without other warranties.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, neither party is liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages. Velkina's total liability arising out of the Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid by Client for the Services giving rise to the claim in the 12 months preceding the event.

sections.title: Indemnity
body: Each party will indemnify the other against third-party claims arising from breach of the Agreement, gross negligence or willful misconduct.

sections.title: Term & Termination
body: The Agreement begins on the effective date of the Order and continues until completion unless terminated earlier for material breach (after notice and cure period) or for convenience as specified in the Order.

sections.title: Subcontracting
body: We may use vetted subcontractors and specialists. We remain responsible for the Services.

sections.title: Publicity
body: With Client consent, we may list Client name and non-confidential outcomes for portfolio/marketing.

sections.title: Governing Law & Disputes
body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of Turkey. Disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Istanbul courts, without prejudice to mandatory consumer or data protection rules.

sections.title: Force Majeure
body: Neither party is liable for failure or delay due to events beyond reasonable control.

sections.title: Entire Agreement; Changes
body: The Order together with these Terms constitutes the entire agreement and supersedes prior understandings. Changes must be in writing. If any provision is invalid, the remainder remains in effect.

sections.title: Notices
body: Notices may be given by email to the addresses specified in the Order and are deemed received upon confirmation or the next business day.

useCases.heading: Where agents pay off
useCases.description: Six places we have shipped agents that earned their keep. Yours is probably one of these — or close to it.

items.title: Customer service
items.description: Multilingual, 24/7, escalates to a human when the question goes off-script. Example: a restaurant's reservation + question line answering bookings, menu and dietary questions in three languages.

items.title: Internal ops
items.description: An agent that owns repetitive triage — incoming tickets routed by topic, documents classified by type, expense requests pre-approved against your policy before they hit a person.

items.title: Sales & qualification
items.description: An agent that talks to inbound leads, asks the budget, timeline and use case, then books a call on your team's calendar only when the lead actually fits.

items.title: Content & marketing
items.description: Feed it your brand voice and product feed; it drafts social posts, ad variants and email sequences in your tone. You approve, it ships.

items.title: Data extraction
items.description: PDFs, scanned invoices, contract attachments, messy email threads — turned into structured rows ready for your spreadsheet, database or accounting tool.

items.title: Custom workflows
items.description: Lead scoring on your rules, meeting transcripts summarized into action items, support tickets written from raw chat logs. Your playbook, executed by an agent.

process.heading: How we build it
process.description: Four steps from "we should try AI" to a working agent that earns its cost.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: We shadow the workflow for two days. We watch the people doing it, count the volume, and find the parts that are pattern, not judgment.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.description: First working agent in one to two weeks, running against real data on a sandbox channel. You see it answer; we tune what is off.

steps.title: Train & measure
steps.description: We track accuracy, cost per task and escalation rate every week. Anything below the bar gets retrained on the actual failure cases.

steps.title: Ship & maintain
steps.description: Go live with monitoring on every conversation. Weekly retraining loop, monthly report, alerting when the agent drifts.

included.heading: What you get
items: Hosted on your infrastructure or ours — your call, your data residency.
Integrations with Slack, Email, WhatsApp, your CRM, your ticketing tool. If it has an API, we connect it.
Measured weekly: response time, deflection rate, cost per conversation. No black box.
Human-in-the-loop on the parts that matter — the agent flags, your team decides.
Handover playbooks so YOU own the agent at the end, not us. Lock-in is not the business model.

notForThis.heading: When AI agents don't make sense
notForThis.body: We will tell you to skip this if it does not fit. Low volume — under about 50 events a day — usually does not pay back the build cost. High-judgment work where being wrong matters in a real way (medical advice, legal interpretation, anything safety-critical) belongs with a trained human. Anything where a single bad answer is unrecoverable is not what agents are for. If your problem looks like one of those, we will say so on the first call.

why.heading: Why Velkina
why.body: We have built and shipped agents for live products — Lavinia's QR menu in Bucharest, Nova Health's clinic workflows, EduTurkia's university advising chat. Turkish, Romanian, English are native; German, Spanish and more are available out of the box. We come from operations as much as software, so we know what an agent has to actually do to make a team's week easier. And we price honestly — a build, a monthly, a handover. No mystery retainer.

cta.heading: Want to harness AI for your business?
cta.description: Tell us the workflow. We will tell you if an agent fits, and what it would take to ship.
